_help._file: How the game picks between versions of a sound (the sounds themselves — files, loudness, variation, cooldowns — are in content/audio.json, the Dev Kit's Sound tab). A bigger popped group plays goop.pop lower and louder.
_help.popSmallCells: A popped group this size or smaller plays goop.pop as it is.
_help.popBigCells: A popped group this size or bigger plays goop.pop at its lowest and loudest (popBigPitch, popBigVolumeDb). In between it slides.
_help.popBigPitch: How much lower the biggest pops are, in semitones (-12 = an octave lower).
_help.popBigVolumeDb: How much louder the biggest pops are, in dB.
